Type: black dome pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: industrial, retro, mid-century modern
Materials: matte black metal shade, polished chrome band and fitter, frosted diffuser
Colors: matte black, chrome silver, white
Shape: wide domed shade with chrome rim band and side screws, flat diffuser underneath, hangs on thin cord, medium size
Feel: bold, crisp, nostalgic
Goes with: dark wood, white walls, chrome accents; industrial or modern dining rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Café Ceiling Pendant Light Chandelier Fixture, 10.75"W x 58.75" Cord, Matte Black and Chrome
product.description: This sleek, black matte-finished dome pendant is the ultimate in modern sophistication. A chrome band adds a bold, handsome style touch, while the clear cord can be adjusted to just the right height for a kitchen, living room or entryway. 12"W x 12"D. 10.75"-58.75" cord can be adjusted for height. Clear cord, black matte-finished metal with chrome trim, frosted glass Clean lines, along with black and chrome finishes, provide a contemporary style. Bulbs not included Intended for indoor use only Professional installation suggested
